precipitation.contingency_scores: equitable threat score and frequency bias at the same thresholds
precipitation.guardrail_statistic: case mean over accumulation windows of FSS at the guardrail threshold and neighborhood
precipitation.model_field: run-total grid-scale precipitation differenced over the accumulation window

promotion.chaos_floor: the cross-case median difference must exceed the twin band for the same score
promotion.guardrail_rule: no guardrail may degrade the cross-case median by more than that metric's own twin band
promotion.integrity_rule: every scored integration passed its dual-run byte screen, every observation re-hashed clean, every receipt carries its registration hash and evaluator commit, and no stand-in input appears anywhere in the evidence
promotion.interaction_rule: single-patch arms are the promotion evidence; a combined-patch arm is reported and is never a promotion basis
promotion.test: one-sided exact Wilcoxon signed-rank test on the per-case differences, H1: median > 0
promotion.twin_band_statistic: median over cases of |S(twin) - S(control)| for the same score
promotion.zero_difference_policy: exact-zero differences are dropped and the sample size reduced (Wilcoxon 1945); tied magnitudes take average ranks and the null distribution is enumerated over sign assignments of the observed absolute ranks, which keeps the test exact under ties

reflectivity.frame_selection: inside the matching tolerance, the scored frame is the nearest frame whose observed fraction meets the coverage floor (ties to the earlier frame); a lead whose whole window is below the floor is recorded missing-obs, named in the score record, and left out of the lead mean. The tolerance itself does not widen
reflectivity.frequency_matched_definition: the model threshold is the linear-interpolated quantile of the model field over the shared-valid scored cells at 1 - f_obs, so model and observed exceedance coverage agree
reflectivity.fss_definition: Roberts & Lean 2008 with a shared validity mask: neighborhood fraction = boxcar(event AND valid)/boxcar(valid); cells with an empty neighborhood are dropped; FSS = 1 when both fraction fields are identically zero over the scored region
reflectivity.missing_policy: observed missing or flagged cells are excluded from both fields; an arm with a missing frame fails, it is not skipped
reflectivity.model_field: column maximum over k of REFL_10CM, each model's own scheme-consistent reflectivity operator
reflectivity.primary_scalar: mean over the scored leads of FSS at the primary threshold and primary neighborhood

parameters.spinup_policy: leads before the first scored hour are reported separately and never scored

surface.guardrail_statistic: median over stations of the per-station RMSE
surface.model_diagnostics: surface diagnostics come from the mandated science core; the battery reimplements none of them
surface.pairing: one frozen station set per case scores every arm; a (station, hour) with no report inside the tolerance is missing for all arms
surface.station_admission: inside the interior mask, land, |model terrain - station elevation| <= tolerance (dropped, never corrected), reporting at least the minimum fraction of scored hours

twin.perturbation: one documented FP ULP on the wrfinput theta field (tools/n5s/perturb_ulp.py)
